question:
You are helping Sara, who runs a furniture workshop near Oujda. Here is what they told you, in their own order.
The workshop makes tables and bookcases.
Each of the tables needs 3 units of wood, 7 machine hours, and earns a profit of 119 dollars.
Each of the bookcases needs 4 units of wood, 8 machine hours, and earns a profit of 22 dollars.
Office rent is 7,600 dollars per month, paid whatever the plan.
This week the workshop has 62 units of wood and 125 machine hours available.
The parking lot has 23 spaces, 5 of them reserved for visitors.
Everything produced will be sold, and only whole units can be made.
Around 62% of customers said they were satisfied in the last survey.
The business was founded in 2007 in Casablanca and now employs 71 people.
How many of each product should be made to maximise total profit?
answer_keys: The maximum total profit in dollars
objective_key: The maximum total profit in dollars
independent_check: brute force over every production plan
